title: Efficient Inner-Product Masking for x·g(x)
summary: A related efficient method is cited, but an analogous secure construction under inner-product masking remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct an efficient IP-masking algorithm that securely evaluates $x\cdot g(x)$ for linear $g$, analogous to [17].

scope.domain: This concerns symmetric cryptography, specifically inner-product masking for masked nonlinear-component evaluation.
parameters: g, the linear function used in the evaluation
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether an analogous efficient algorithm can be devised for secure evaluation under IP masking remains unresolved.

progress.summary: The source explicitly leaves this as open work, asking whether a similar algorithm can be devised for IP masking. It reports no construction or resolution.
citation_labels: Josep Balasch et al., Consolidating Inner Product Masking
